textos.Marceneiros e auxiliares de marcenaria,: Cabinetmakers and woodworking assistants, in Rio de Janeiro
textos.Cada peça do Estúdio MABE é feita uma ún: Every Estúdio MABE piece is made only once, in solid wood, with the joinery left visible. It is work that depends on who is at the bench, so we are always open to meeting people of the craft.
textos.Para quem já trabalha com madeira maciça: For those who already work with solid wood and master the whole process: reading the drawings, cutting, making the joints, assembling and finishing.
textos.Para quem quer trabalhar ao lado dos mar: For those who want to work alongside the cabinetmakers, preparing the wood, assembling and finishing, and learn the craft day to day in the studio.
textos.Mande uma mensagem pelo WhatsApp com seu: Send a WhatsApp message with your name, the role you are looking for and a little about your experience. If you have photos of pieces you have made, send them too: they say more than any CV.
textos.Design Autoral Brasileiro · Madeira\u00a: Brazilian Authorial Design · Solid Wood · Rio de Janeiro · Handmade
textos.Cada peça nasce de uma conversa entre o: Every piece begins as a conversation between the craftsman and the wood. What comes out of it is not furniture: it is a decision about how you want to live.
textos.\"Acreditamos que permanência é um ato d: "We believe permanence is an act of respect: for the space, for the people who live in it and for the hands that made it."
textos.O Estúdio MABE nasce da convicção de que: Estúdio MABE was born from the conviction that real furniture is not chosen by the eye alone. It is chosen by the touch of the wood, by the thickness of the silence it brings to a room, by the feeling that the piece had always been there, waiting for the right space. We work with certified wood of traceable origin, joinery techniques passed down through generations and a process that always begins by listening.
textos.Do corte à última demão de óleo, cada ge: From the first cut to the last coat of oil, every gesture has a reason.
textos.Um processo que respeita o tempo de cada: A process that respects the time each piece asks for
textos.Antes de qualquer risco no papel, ouvimo: Before a single line is drawn, we listen. The space, the light, the way you live. A good project always starts with an honest conversation.
textos.Cada peça é desenhada do zero, com visit: Every piece is drawn from scratch, with a free site visit and 3D renderings, so you see and approve every detail before the wood is touched.
textos.Artesãos experientes trabalham a madeira: Experienced craftsmen work the wood by hand. No shortcuts. Every joint is checked, every surface is felt.
textos.A peça chega ao seu espaço com instalaçã: The piece arrives at your space with installation included and a five-year warranty. We do not deliver furniture. We deliver a place to live in.
textos.Trabalhos que já saíram do estúdio: Work that has left the studio
textos.Cada um feito para uma casa, uma rotina: Each one made for a home, a routine and a person
textos.(toda peça começa com uma conversa hones: (every piece begins with an honest conversation)
textos.\"Fazemos móveis para quem entende que u: "We make furniture for people who understand that a well-inhabited space is, in itself, a form of art."
textos.CNPJ: 63.307.833/0001-10 · Rio de Janeir: Company ID (CNPJ): 63.307.833/0001-10 · Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
textos.Cada móvel, uma intenção. Cada material,: Every piece with an intention. Every material with a reason.
textos.Este catálogo reúne peças que já saíram: This catalogue gathers pieces that have already left the studio and can be made again for your home. New designs are in development, and most of what we do is made to measure: if the piece you are looking for is not here yet, tell us what you need and we will draw it.
textos.Peças que completam o espaço sem disputa: Pieces that complete a space without competing with it
textos.Para quem também faz parte da casa: For those who are also part of the home
textos.Peças pensadas para o conforto e a rotin: Pieces designed for the comfort and the routine of animals, in the same wood language as the rest of the house
textos.Novas peças da Linha Pet estão em desenv: New Pet Line pieces are in development at the studio. In the meantime, if your animal needs something that is not here yet, we design it to measure.
textos.Dois marceneiros, uma convicção: o mundo: Two woodworkers, one conviction: the world has too much furniture and too few well-inhabited spaces.
textos.\"O Estúdio MABE nasceu no Rio de Janeir: "Estúdio MABE was born in Rio de Janeiro out of a friendship and a shared belief: that real joinery begins by listening and ends with a piece that seems to have always been there."
textos.Engenheiro de formação, Mateus encontrou: An engineer by training, Mateus found in woodworking far more than a pastime. Living in Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro, he was caught by the richness and the abundance of Brazilian woods: tauari, freijó, cumaru, each one with its own way of taking the tool. From the exact sciences he brought a certainty that became method: in a joint, the millimetre is not a detail, it is what separates the piece that crosses generations from the one that creaks in its second winter.
textos.Hoje une essa precisão à beleza natural: Today he joins that precision to the natural beauty of wood to create unique, structured pieces. Proportion comes before ornament: a piece without proportion, he likes to say, is a badly written sentence, you understand it, but it bothers you.
textos.Entusiasta do design brasileiro e admira: An enthusiast of Brazilian design and an admirer of Jorge Zalszupin, he leans towards dark woods, fine lines and restrained thicknesses. Stone and glass come in as a second voice, to harmonise with the wood and never to compete with it.
textos.\"Design é a harmonia composta por preci: "Design is the harmony made of precision, proportion and Brazilian woods."
textos.Nascido em Botafogo, no Rio de Janeiro,: Born in Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro, and trained in design, Bernardo has just over eight years devoted to systemic production management. He worked at a large production company, managing major projects for brands such as L'Oréal, Granado, Zara and Melissa, among others, and delivered shop windows for many malls and stores across Rio de Janeiro.
textos.Esse conhecimento multifacetado o aproxi: That many-sided knowledge brought him to the art of woodworking, and he ended up falling in love with solid wood. Bernardo brings Estúdio MABE something rare: the systemic vision of someone who has managed many processes, and the sensitivity of someone who has learned that every grain is a story that deserves to be told with care. Together with Mateus, he founded this studio with a mission that goes beyond a piece of furniture: the two want to bring Rio de Janeiro and Brazil everything that solid wood can offer.
textos.\"Design sem matéria é conceito. Madeira: "Design without matter is a concept. Wood without design is a resource. What we do here is joining the two into something that lasts."
textos.100% de origem rastreável, com certifica: 100% traceable origin, with FSC certification or equivalent
textos.Técnicas transmitidas entre gerações, se: Techniques passed down through generations, with no industrial shortcuts
textos.Cada projeto nasce do zero, a partir do: Every project starts from scratch, from your space and your way of living
textos.Porque confiamos tanto no que fazemos qu: Because we trust our work enough to put it in the contract
textos.Sabemos que o seu nome está em cada proj: We know your name is on every project you sign. That is why we treat each partnership as an extension of your own studio, with the same demands, the same care and the same commitment to the final result.
textos.(SketchUp) gratuitamente para arquitetos: (SketchUp) format, free of charge, for partner architects and designers. The aim is simple: we want you to be free to place, test and compare every piece inside your project before any decision, checking real proportions, finishing details and how each item sits in the room. That way you and your client reach the right choice with far more confidence.
textos., atualizados a cada nova peça e enviado: , updated with every new piece and sent by e-mail within 24 hours of the request.
textos.Os arquivos são enviados gratuitamente p: The files are sent free of charge by e-mail within 24 hours. For custom blocks or bespoke pieces already in progress, talk directly to Mateus or Bernardo.
textos.Toda a nossa coleção em formato .skp, em: Our whole collection in .skp format, at real scale, so you can test, compare and decide precisely before any meeting with your client.
textos.Arquitetos e designers credenciados têm: Accredited architects and designers have access to special prices, priority lead times and dedicated support.
textos.Respeitamos cada detalhe do seu memorial: We respect every detail of your specification. When in doubt, we ask before we build. Never the other way round.
textos.Datas acordadas são datas cumpridas. Com: Agreed dates are dates we meet. We flag any variation early, because your site schedule does not wait.
textos.Disponibilizamos amostras de materiais e: We provide material samples and carry out free site visits for projects in development.
textos.Com sua autorização, divulgamos o projet: With your permission, we publish the project crediting the partner practice: mutual visibility, always respecting authorship.
textos.\"Seu projeto merece uma execução à altu: "Your project deserves an execution worthy of it."
textos.Entre em contato e converse com Mateus o: Get in touch and talk to Mateus or Bernardo about how we can work together.
textos.Da primeira conversa à peça pronta: trab: From the first conversation to the finished piece: work that has left the studio and is now part of someone's home.
textos.Cada projeto começa por uma conversa. Nã: Every project starts with a conversation. There is no standard form for a home with character, so we would rather listen to you before proposing anything.
textos.Sem compromisso. Apenas uma boa conversa: No commitment. Just a good conversation about your space.
textos.O botão abre o WhatsApp com estes dados: The button opens WhatsApp with these details already written in the message. See how we look after them in our
textos.Fale sobre o ambiente, o que você sente: Tell us about the room, what you miss in the space today, style references, preferred materials...
textos.Em até 24 horas, Mateus ou Bernardo entr: Within 24 hours, Mateus or Bernardo will get in touch to talk about your project.
textos.(CNPJ 63.307.833/0001-10), com sede no R: (company ID 63.307.833/0001-10), based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, handles your personal data, in accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018, the LGPD).
textos.Coletamos apenas os dados que você nos e: We only collect the data you send us: your name, telephone, e-mail and the description of your project, when you fill in the contact form or talk to us on WhatsApp or by e-mail. If you apply through the Careers page, you also send us the role you are looking for, a summary of your experience and, if you wish, photos of pieces you have made.
textos.O site em si não tem cadastro, login nem: The site itself has no sign-up, login or payment, and does not store this data: the form only composes the message and opens WhatsApp with it. Beyond that, the site only counts visits, anonymously, as explained in section 6.
textos.Usamos seus dados apenas para responder: We use your data only to answer your enquiry, prepare quotes and carry your project through to delivery. Applicants' data is used only to assess the application. We do not sell, rent or pass on your data to anyone for marketing, and we do not send you messages you did not ask for.
textos.Para o site funcionar e para conversarmo: To run the site and to talk with you, we use services from other companies, each of which receives only what its job requires:
textos.Vercel, que hospeda o site e faz a conta: Vercel, which hosts the site and runs the visit count described in section 6. Like any server, it records technical data about each visit, such as the IP address and the type of browser.
textos.Google Fonts, que entrega as fontes do s: Google Fonts, which serves the site's typefaces. When you open a page, your browser fetches the fonts from Google's servers, which receive your IP address.
textos.WhatsApp, da Meta. O formulário de conta: WhatsApp, owned by Meta. The contact form opens WhatsApp with what you typed already filled into the message, and from that moment the data passes through WhatsApp, even before you tap send.
textos.Gmail, do Google, onde recebemos e respo: Gmail, from Google, where we receive and answer e-mail.
textos.O link para o Instagram apenas leva ao n: The Instagram link only takes you to our profile: the site loads nothing from Instagram.
textos.Os dados de um pedido de orçamento ficam: Data from a quote request is kept while the conversation is ongoing and for up to 12 months after the last contact, in case you want to pick the project up again. If you place an order, we keep what is needed for as long as the law requires for tax records and for the warranty of the piece. Applications are kept for up to 12 months. You can ask for deletion sooner, at any time.
textos.Adotamos medidas razoáveis de segurança: We take reasonable security measures to protect your data against unauthorised access.
textos.O site guarda no seu próprio navegador,: The site keeps only three things in your own browser, without sending them to anyone: the pieces you added to your selection, your choice between light and dark theme and, if the cookie notice is active, your answer to it. They are needed for the site to work and do not depend on consent. The site sets no cookies.
textos.Contamos as visitas com o Vercel Web Ana: We count visits with Vercel Web Analytics: how many people come in, which pages they see, where they arrived from (such as Instagram or Google), country and city, and the type of device and browser. It uses no cookies and does not identify you: each visit is recognised by a code that is discarded within 24 hours, and we only see totals. We do not use Google Analytics or Google Ads. If we ever start using them, this policy will be updated first, and they will only be switched on after you accept the cookie notice shown when you enter the site. If you decline, the site works just the same.
textos.Nos termos da LGPD, você pode solicitar: Under the Brazilian data protection law (LGPD) you may request at any time: confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymisation or deletion of your data, as well as the withdrawal of consent. To exercise these rights, write to
textos.Dúvidas sobre esta política podem ser en: Questions about this policy can be sent to the e-mail above or by WhatsApp on +55 21 99029-1331.

textos.Rack e escrivaninha suspensos em freijó,: Wall-mounted unit and desk in freijó, for Clarissa Xavier
textos.Rack suspenso e escrivaninha flutuante c: Wall-mounted media unit and floating desk with hidden storage, in natural freijó veneer
textos.Para a casa de Clarissa, na Urca, desenh: For Clarissa's home in Urca, we designed two pieces fixed straight to the wall, floating above the floor so the rooms breathe. In the living room, the unit has side doors for what does not need to be on show, a central niche for the equipment and round handles in solid ipê that bring the dark contrast. The desk hides a storage box under the top, which opens on hinges, and has a built-in cable outlet to keep the surface free of wires.
textos.Mesa de cabeceira em tauari, para Glória: Bedside table in tauari, for Glória Dantas
textos.Mesa de cabeceira com duas gavetas e pra: Bedside table with two drawers and a slatted shelf, in solid tauari
textos.Linhas retas e proporções enxutas, pensa: Straight lines and lean proportions, meant to sit beside the bed without weighing on the room. The drawers need no handle: a cut-out in the front does that job. Below, the slatted shelf keeps the piece light and shows the joints of the structure, with the pale, even grain of tauari in full view.
textos.Mesa de cabeceira em tauari com palha in: Bedside table in tauari with woven cane, for Danilo
textos.Mesa de cabeceira em tauari maciço, com: Bedside table in solid tauari, with a single drawer, shellac finish and a woven cane shelf
textos.Danilo acompanha o estúdio de perto, e a: Danilo follows the studio closely, and the choices that define this piece were his: a single drawer and, below it, a woven cane shelf, because he values work done by hand. The bedside table was made in solid tauari, with softened edges so the body meets only curves, and the drawer opens through a groove carved into the front, with no handle to catch the sheets. The finish is shellac, applied in thin coats the way it was done on old pieces: it brings out the grain and leaves a soft sheen that the morning light reveals slowly. The woven cane lightens the piece and lets the air through.
textos.Banco de meditação em madeira maciça, pa: Meditation bench in solid wood, for Tales
textos.Banco para meditação na postura seiza, e: Meditation bench for the seiza posture, in solid wood with an oil varnish finish
textos.Tales medita e pratica ioga no Grajaú, e: Tales meditates and practises yoga in Grajaú, and knows well the moment when the body interrupts the practice before the mind does: the knee complains, the foot goes numb, the session ends. The bench exists to postpone that moment. In the seiza posture it takes the weight that used to fall on the ankles, lets the legs rest under the seat and the spine align on its own, without effort. We made it in solid wood, with the sides angled so it holds without sliding, every corner rounded by hand where the leg touches, and an oil varnish finish that protects without taking away the feel of the wood.
textos.Gaveteiro em cedrinho maciço, para Kamil: Chest of drawers in solid cedrinho, for Kamile Seiva
textos.Gaveteiro embutido em cedrinho maciço, c: Built-in chest of drawers in solid cedrinho, with fluted fronts and concealed runners
textos.Numa casa inteira forrada de madeira, qu: In a house lined entirely in wood, any new piece risks looking like a patch. This chest of drawers was designed to belong: the fluted fronts in solid cedrinho break the light into vertical stripes, echo the panelling on the walls and fill the niche as though they had always been there, under the pale stone top. The runners are concealed, with no hardware in sight, so the drawer glides and the wood reads as one surface. The handles were chosen together with the architect Kamile Seiva, to repeat the aged metal the house already had.
textos.Mesa para estúdio musical feita em cumar: Desk for a music studio in cumaru with a marble top, client Kamile Seiva.
textos.Móvel sob medida para estúdio musical em: Bespoke piece for a home music studio, in solid cumaru with a marble top
textos.Desenhado pelo Estúdio MABE em conversa: Designed by Estúdio MABE in conversation with the architect Kamile Seiva, the piece was made for the music studio her husband keeps at home. The body is solid cumaru, a dense wood with a warm tone, and the marble top gives the firm, cool surface the equipment asks for. The drawers open through a round hole cut into the front, with no visible handle, and the slatted faces follow the same restrained design as the counter, which faces the green outside the window.
textos.Tauari maciço · Medidas: 50×40×60 cm · P: Solid tauari · Size: 50×40×60 cm · Handles carved into the wood itself
textos.Tauari maciço · Medidas: 198×97×55 cm ·: Solid tauari · Size: 198×97×55 cm · Pull-out bed under the slats
textos.Uma bicama em tauari maciço, para o quar: A trundle bed in solid tauari, for the bedroom that sometimes needs to welcome one more person. The pull-out bed sits under the slats, and the fronts need no visible hardware: a circle carved into the wood itself takes the finger, and the grain runs across the piece with nothing to interrupt it. The corners are rounded by hand, because this is a piece the body finds in the dark, before the eyes do. Made to order, 198 cm long by 97 cm wide, and it can be adjusted to the size of your mattress.
textos.Tauari maciço · Medidas: 50×40×60 cm · P: Solid tauari · Size: 50×40×60 cm · Woven cane shelf
textos.Tauari maciço e palha indiana, numa peça: Solid tauari and woven cane, in a piece made by hand from start to finish. The top has softened corners, and the drawer opens through a recess carved into its own front, with no handle to catch on the sheets. Below, the woven cane shelf celebrates handwork: its open weave makes the piece look lighter and lets the air through. A bedside table made to stay within reach for many years.

textos.A primeira leva de itens decorativos est: The first batch of decorative objects is being made at the studio. They are small, bench-made pieces that ask for the same care as the large ones, so they take their time. They will appear here soon.
textos.Os primeiros projetos realizados estão a: The first completed projects are on their way. In the meantime, have a look at the pieces in the catalogue.

textos.Cama em tauari maciço, para Marcos Zisma: Bed in solid tauari, for Marcos Zisman
textos.Cama em tauari maciço, com duas gavetas: Bed in solid tauari, with two drawers under the base and pulls carved into the wood itself
textos.Numa cama encostada na parede, o espaço: In a bed set against the wall, the space that matters most is the one underneath. This one was made entirely in solid tauari, on a closed base that turns the gap where normally only dust lives into two wide drawers. The fronts do without visible hardware: a circle carved into the wood itself takes the finger, and the pale grain crosses the piece with nothing to interrupt it. The corners were rounded by hand, because this is a piece the body meets in the dark, before the eyes do. The tauari arrived pale and stayed that way, with a finish that protects without hiding: against the blue of the wall and the herringbone parquet, it is the wood that settles the room.
textos.Rack suspenso em peroba do campo, para S: Wall-mounted unit in peroba do campo, for Stella
textos.Rack suspenso em folhas naturais de pero: Wall-mounted unit in natural peroba do campo veneer, finished in beeswax, with push-to-open doors and a curved end
textos.Um móvel que toca o chão divide a sala e: A cabinet that touches the floor cuts the room in two. This one does not touch: it hangs on the wall, and the floor runs underneath it without a break. The leaves are natural peroba do campo, chosen so the figure of the wood crosses the doors with no visible join, as if the piece had come out of a single block. There is no handle anywhere: the door opens at a touch, and nothing breaks the surface. The finish is beeswax, which leaves no film over the wood: the hand lands on the material itself, with the softness only wax gives. And where most units end in a sharp corner, this one curves and follows the wall, holding the room instead of cutting it.

You receive photos of the work in progress on WhatsApp.
